needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, hard-surfaced footway of at least 1.5 m along the left side to separate pedestrians from the parked cars and the building frontages.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road consists of a continuous row of parked cars, leaving no space for pedestrians to walk safely off the carriageway.
